meta.title: {brand} · Lost & found licence plates in Thailand
meta.description: Lost a licence plate in a flood, or found one? Post it here and we match plate numbers straight away. Free, no ads.

consent.label: I agree that my plate number and contact details are stored to match plates, and that the other person sees my contact details when there's a match. Everything is deleted automatically within 60 days.

contact.title: How to reach you
contact.introLost: Only the person who found your plate sees this, and only once there is a match. Add at least one.
contact.introFound: Only the plate's owner sees this, and only once there is a match. Add at least one.

pin.title: PIN to manage your post
pin.intro: Use this PIN with the plate number to manage your post from any device: mark the plate as returned, extend or delete it on the “Manage a post” page.
pin.label: 4–6 digit PIN
pin.hint: Write it down: we can't see your PIN. No simple sequences or repeats like 1234 or 1111.

lost.title: I lost a plate
lost.plateIntro: Enter the number of the lost plate. We'll check right away whether someone has found it.
lost.foundAlreadyBody: Compare the photo with your plate first. If it is yours, get the finder’s contact details from the card below.
lost.notFoundYet: Nobody has found this plate yet. Report it lost and it will be matched automatically when someone does.
lost.doneTitle: Your lost plate is reported. It will be matched automatically when someone finds it.
lost.doneManage: Check matches and manage the post under “My posts” on this device. On another device, use the plate number and your PIN on “Manage a post”.
lost.doneMatches: Someone may have found your plate
lost.alsoWatch: Report it lost too, in case more turn up

found.title: I found a plate
found.intro: Take a photo of the plates you found and we'll help find their owners. One photo can contain several plates.
found.privacyNote: Only the cropped plate images are sent, never the full photo, and location data is removed.
found.drawHint: Drag on the photo to draw a box around a plate not added yet.
found.useWhole: Add the whole photo as 1 plate

found.needPlates: Add at least one plate first.
found.policeNoteHint: e.g. Mueang Chiang Mai Police Station
found.legalNote: Finders should return plates to their owners or hand them to the police.
found.districtHint: Just the district, no address. The owner sees it after asking for your contact details.

found.doneBody: We'll match these plates with owners who reported them lost, and keep matching as new reports come in.
found.ownerLooking: The plate's owner is looking for it!

found.reviewNote: This plate will be shown after a moderator checks it.

found.addedFromPhoto: {count, plural, one {# plate added from this photo} other {# plates added from this photo}}

search.intro: Search plates that people have found and posted.
search.nearHint: The number may differ slightly. Compare it with the photo.
search.none: Nobody has found this plate yet

match.title: Match details
match.nearBody: The numbers are close. The owner should compare the photo before arranging a handover.
match.atPolice: The plate is at a police station
match.finderBody: Contact the owner to arrange the handover. At the handover, ask to see their registration book and ID card, and check the name and plate number match.
match.youAreOwner: This is your plate. Contact the finder with the button below.
match.finderReminder: If you haven't seen a registration book and ID card showing they own it, don't hand the plate over yet.

reveal.intro: To protect yourself from scams, always:
reveal.tip1: If anyone asks you to transfer money before you have the plate back, don't pay.
reveal.tip2: Ask the finder for a photo of the plate next to a paper with your name on it, to prove they have it.
reveal.tip3: Bring your registration book and ID card to the handover, to show the plate is yours.
reveal.tip4: Meet in a public place or at a police station.
reveal.acknowledge: I've read this and will follow it
reveal.reminder: If anyone asks you to transfer money before you have the plate back, don't pay.

about.title: About {brand}
about.lead: {brand} helps licence plates lost in floods get back to their owners. Owners register the plate number, finders send a photo, and we match them. Free, with no ads.

owner.a: Tap “I lost a plate”, type the plate number and choose the province.
owner.b: If someone has already found it, you see it straight away. Compare the photo with your plate, then get the finder’s contact details.
owner.c: If not, add your contact details, set a PIN and report it lost. When someone finds it, it is matched automatically. Check “My posts” for matches.

finder.a: Tap “I found a plate” and take a photo. One photo can hold several plates.
finder.b: Plates are found and read automatically. If one is missed, drag a box around it and tap “Crop this plate”. Always check the number and province.
finder.c: Add your contact details and send. If the owner has reported it lost, you see the owner’s contact details.
finder.d: Return the plate yourself, or hand it in at a police station.

handover.a: If anyone asks you to transfer money before you have the plate back, don’t pay.
handover.b: Owners bring the registration book and ID card; finders ask to see them before handing over.
handover.c: Meet in a public place or at a police station.

items.a: {brand} is a free, non-profit service that only matches plate numbers. We never hold, collect or deliver plates.
items.b: We do not verify who users are. Check for yourself before meeting or handing over a plate. We are not liable for loss or harm from contact or handovers between users.
items.c: Post only true details of a plate you lost or found. No false posts, scams, demands for money, or using someone’s contact details for anything else.
items.d: Finders should return plates to their owners or hand them to the police.
items.e: Automatic plate reading can be wrong; check before sending. The service is provided as is and may pause at times.
items.f: We may hide or remove posts that break these terms, and may update the terms; the date of the last update is shown on this page.

privacy.title: Privacy

collect.a: The plate number, province and note you enter
collect.b: The contact details you enter (LINE ID, phone, email)
collect.d: Your PIN, stored one-way hashed: we cannot read it
collect.e: Your IP address, turned into a code that changes daily, used only against spam and abuse

not.a: Full photos: photos are cropped on your device and only the plate is sent
not.b: GPS location or other data embedded in photos
not.c: Names, ID card or bank account numbers (the forms reject them)
not.d: No ads, no trackers, and we never sell data

share.a: Contact details: only the matched person, after reading the scam warning
share.b: Lost plates never appear in search, so scammers cannot browse them
share.c: Services we use: Supabase (database and photo storage), Vercel (website), Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection)

privacy.keep: Posts and photos are deleted automatically within {days} days. To have yours deleted sooner, or for any privacy question, email us below.

manage.title: Manage a post
manage.intro: Enter a plate number from your post (any plate in it) and the PIN you set when posting. Then you can mark the plate as returned, extend or delete the post from this device.
manage.pinHint: The 4–6 digit PIN you set when posting
